title: ARG State Variables
description: Core narrative state tracked throughout the experience

agency_trust.description: Relationship with handler agency. At 0, agency becomes hostile.

chen_trust.description: Relationship with Chen Wei-lin. Affects ending options.

pinkerton_awareness.description: How much the Pinkertons know about the investigation. At 80, assassins deploy.

kaniksu_knowledge.description: Understanding of the Jesuit/Kaniksu conspiracy. Unlocks deeper narrative.

panda_truth.description: Whether panda origin revelation has been discovered.

chimera_awareness.description: Whether organ-container truth about pandas is known.

is_caught.description: Whether player has been captured by agency.

escaped_cell.description: Whether player has escaped agency custody.

final_choice_made.description: Whether endgame decision has been executed.

chen_dialogue_complete.description: Whether Chen Wei-lin dialogue tree resolved.

mathias_true_allegiance_known.description: Whether Father Mathias's true nature discovered.

inventory.description: List of item IDs currently held.

truth_level.description: Computed property: progress through truth discovery phases. (Engine may recompute.)
